author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: EPUB zero-count tab only receives unavailable styling from the all-results mode.
findings.consequence: When the EPUB count is zero and the user is on latest, authors, works, or parts, the EPUB tab appears normally available while the matching PDF tab is styled as unavailable outside its active mode. This creates an inconsistent availability cue between equivalent download-format tabs.
findings.evidence: The EPUB tab sets disabledLook with `currentMode.value === "all" && !epubTabCount.value`, while the sibling PDF tab uses the broader non-active check. The inspected `LibraryModeTabs` consumer turns disabledLook for EPUB/PDF into the unavailable visual class.
findings.recommendation: Use the same non-active zero-count rule as PDF, e.g. `currentMode.value !== "epub" && !epubTabCount.value`, unless EPUB intentionally has different product semantics and that rule is covered by a test.
